services.name: Tree Pruning
services.tagline: Clean cuts that keep your tree healthy for decades.
services.shortDescription: Selective pruning to remove dead, diseased, or interfering branches. Improves tree health, shape, and safety without compromising long-term growth.
services.description:
Pruning is the difference between a tree that thrives and a tree that becomes a liability. Every cut is intentional: removing what is dead, diseased, or interfering, preserving what is structurally sound. Mature shade trees, young trees that need shaping, fruit trees that need rejuvenation, ornamental trees that have grown into problem zones.

Most residential pruning jobs are completed in a single visit. You get a free quote before any work starts, and a clean yard when we leave (debris hauled or chipped onsite, depending on your preference).
process: Walk the property with you, identify which trees need work
Quote each tree separately so you can choose scope and budget
Climb or use a pole saw and pole pruner depending on the cut height
Three-cut technique on larger limbs to prevent bark tearing
Chip or haul debris based on your call
goodFor: Mature shade trees that have not been pruned in 5+ years
Branches overhanging the house, driveway, deck, or sidewalk
Young trees that need structural pruning for long-term shape
Storm damage cleanup (broken or hanging limbs)
Crown thinning to let more light through to the lawn or garden

services.name: Limb Removal
services.tagline: Hanging, broken, or in the way? Down it goes.
services.shortDescription: Removal of individual large limbs that are dead, broken, hanging, or interfering with structures. The middle ground between light pruning and full tree removal.
services.description:
Sometimes a tree is fundamentally healthy but one or two limbs are problems: a hanging branch from a storm, a limb growing into power lines or onto the roof, a dead leader that is about to fall. Removing those specific limbs is faster and cheaper than full tree work, and it solves the immediate hazard.

We focus on this kind of targeted limb work. Roped descents from the crown for awkward limbs over structures, careful sectioning to control where the wood lands, and clean cuts at the trunk that let the tree heal properly. Most limb removals are a same-day or next-evening job.
process: Assess the limb and identify safe rigging points
Set rope and lower line for any limb over a structure
Section the limb (cut from the tip back) to keep wood under control
Make a final clean cut at the collar to allow the tree to heal
Chip or haul wood and clean up the site
goodFor: Dead leader branches that are dropping deadwood
Limbs over the roof, garage, deck, fence, pool, or driveway
Single problem limb on an otherwise healthy tree

services.name: Full Tree Removal
services.shortDescription: Full tree removal is in the launch plan but not yet offered. Pruning and limb work first, full removals will be added once the rig and crew are scaled for it.
services.description:
Full tree removal requires bucket-truck access (for street trees) or experienced ground crew with rigging gear (for backyard removals). Both are in the plan. For now, we focus on pruning and limb removal jobs that can be done safely with current tools and experience.

If you need a full tree taken down soon, send a photo of the tree and we will tell you who to call.
